cases.name: network-managed-least-privilege
cases.tradeoff: L3 requires explicit same-file reference paths connecting managed service, network and narrow IAM structure; applied/effective behavior is not claimed.

cases.name: provider-only
cases.tradeoff: A provider declaration establishes configured identity only and cannot prove provisioned resources.

cases.name: wildcard-policy
cases.tradeoff: Wildcard action/resource literals fail the conservative least-privilege predicate.

cases.name: unrelated-resource-sum
cases.tradeoff: Network, managed and narrow IAM resources without explicit reference paths must not combine into an L3 architecture claim.

cases.name: comment-and-heredoc-lookalike
cases.tradeoff: Commented and heredoc resource text is not executable Terraform structure.
